messages.subject: ME/7104/25 Pennington/Halworth — Initial Enforcement Order
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Osei,

Please find attached the Initial Enforcement Order made today under section 72(2) of the Enterprise Act 2002 in relation to your client's completed acquisition of Halworth Pump Systems Limited. The Order takes effect immediately. We draw your attention to the requirement to appoint a Hold Separate Manager within ten working days and to provide a first compliance statement within 14 days.

Requests for derogations should be made in writing to the case team.

Regards
Lydia Cho
Case Officer, Mergers | Competition and Markets Authority

messages.subject: RE: ME/7104/25 Pennington/Halworth — derogation requests
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Cho,

Thank you. Our client will comply fully. We will notify the Hold Separate Manager shortly. We write to request three derogations to permit steps that do not prejudice a reference: (1) continued provision of group treasury and statutory consolidation/reporting functions; (2) shared IT security/patching of Halworth systems; and (3) participation by Halworth in the group's existing insurance renewal. Short justifications for each are set out below. We would be grateful for the case team's agreement.

Regards
James Osei

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0531
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.snippet: Dear Mr Osei, The case team is content to grant derogations (1)–(3) on the terms requested, subject
messages.subject: RE: ME/7104/25 Pennington/Halworth — derogation requests
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Osei,

The case team is content to grant derogations (1)–(3) on the terms requested, subject to the condition that no commercially sensitive information of Halworth relating to pricing, customers or tenders is shared with the retained business save through the agreed clean-team arrangements. Please confirm acceptance and we will record the derogations in writing.

Regards
Lydia Cho
